room_rent.note: Exclusive plan entitles insured to single occupancy or higher accommodation; daily cash paid if insured opts for shared room instead

icu.note: ICU covered as part of in-patient treatment with no stated sub-limit

sub_limits.note: Road ambulance ₹2,000/hosp; air ambulance up to ₹2.5L/hosp (inbuilt); maternity sub-limited; daily cash for shared room up to ₹1,000/day max ₹6,000; recovery benefit ₹10,000 lump sum; no disease-wise sub-limits on main in-patient cover

maternity.note: Individual: Normal ₹30,000, C-section ₹50,000 (incl. pre/post natal ₹5,000 & newborn ₹5,000); waiting 4 yrs. Family: Normal ₹30,000, C-section ₹50,000 (incl. pre/post natal ₹5,000 & newborn ₹5,000); waiting 3 yrs. Limited to 2 deliveries lifetime. Not subject to in-patient SI.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added each policy year irrespective of claims; max 100% of base SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned for Exclusive variant

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered when insured is recipient; donor's pre/post-hosp excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation; emergency air ambulance inbuilt up to ₹2.5L per hospitalisation within India

modern_treatments.note: No explicit exclusion of modern/robotic treatments; covered under in-patient benefit up to SI

consumables.note: List I in Annexure I explicitly excludes gloves and many consumables

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only

notable_exclusions: Sleep apnoea, external congenital anomalies, hearing aids/spectacles, dental (unless hospitalised), infertility/IVF, self-injury, war, non-allopathic (except AYUSH)
optional_riders: Critical Illness lump sum (50% or 100% of in-patient SI, max ₹10L); Newborn baby cover (if maternity claimed)
